prompt_cn:
【角色资产图】16:9 横版设计稿，用于 AI 漫剧资产库
主体：30岁 / female / 佣兵 / 佣兵-wasteland
面部：棱角分明、饱经风霜, 方下颌、脸颊凹陷, 适中、略突出, 挺直, 轮廓清晰、薄至中等
眼睛：狭长杏眼, 深褐
发型：及腰, 自然, 深棕, 无刘海
体型：175cm, 清瘦结实, 中偏宽
服装：多层废土生存装：破损军用风衣 + 战术背心 + 多口袋工装裤, 层次清晰、一眼可辨
材质：战术尼龙, 边缘磨损、织物沁入沙尘
装备：防风护目镜（推在额头）；腰间机械扳手；战术背包；机械左臂
配色：铁锈棕
版式：左侧半身/头部特写（验五官与材质）；右侧正 / 严格 90° 侧 / 背 三视图
一致性：三视图必须同一角色，头身比 / 服装 / 装备 / 配色 / 材质完全一致
姿态：自然站立，双脚微开，双臂自然下垂，不做剧情动作
背景：纯白或极浅灰影棚背景，无环境叙事
光影：柔和均匀棚拍光，无强烈硬阴影，便于辨认材质
品质：8K 超清、拟真影视级概念设计稿质感
prompt_en:
Create a professional 16:9 landscape character design sheet for a cinematic AI-animation / game production asset library.
CHARACTER: 30-year-old female wasteland mercenary
FACE: angular, weathered, strong jaw, hollow cheeks, moderate, slightly prominent, straight, defined, thin-to-medium
EYES: narrow almond, dark brown
SKIN: natural, weather-exposed, realistic skin texture
DISTINCTIVE MARKS: a shallow pale scar on the left brow tail
HAIR: waist-length, natural, messy layered, dark brown, side-parted, no bangs
BODY: 175cm, lean and weathered, medium-broad, composed, alert
CLOTHING: layered wasteland survival gear: battered military trench coat, tactical vest, multi-pocket cargo trousers, layered, readable at a glance
MATERIALS: tactical nylon, frayed edges, dust-impregnated weave
EQUIPMENT: windproof goggles pushed up on the forehead, mechanical wrench at the waist, tactical backpack, cybernetic left arm
COLOR PALETTE: rust brown, ochre, gray-green, gunmetal titanium
SIGNATURE POINTS: cybernetic left arm
LAYOUT: professional 16:9 landscape character design sheet. LEFT SIDE: a large front-facing half-body portrait of the exact same character, emphasising facial identity, skin texture, eyes, hairstyle, clothing construction and material quality. RIGHT SIDE: three full-body views of the exact same character arranged horizontally — 1) STRICT FRONT VIEW, 2) STRICT 90-DEGREE SIDE VIEW, 3) STRICT BACK VIEW. Base standard: Character turnaround sheet, 16:9, pure white background, seamless white studio background, left side: enlarged head and facial detail close-up, right side: front view full body, side view full body, back view full body, soft even lighting, no harsh shadows, cinematic lighting quality, photorealistic, hyper detailed, 8k visual detail, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no caption, no random symbols
CONSISTENCY: the three views must depict exactly the same character with identical head-to-body ratio, proportions, facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, equipment count and positions, colours and materials. Equipment must appear in the same quantity, position and left/right relation in every view. Neutral standing pose: feet slightly apart, body upright, arms naturally down, no dynamic action, no combat pose. Do not redesign the character between views.
BACKGROUND: pure white background or seamless white studio background, no environmental scene, no scenery, no props.
LIGHTING: soft even studio lighting, subtle ambient illumination, soft contact shadow, no harsh shadows, cinematic lighting quality — so that fabric, skin, metal and leather read clearly.
CINEMATIC QUALITY (concrete, not just the word 'cinematic'): controlled key light, soft fill, subtle rim light, physically plausible falloff, controlled contrast, cinematic depth, foreground / midground / background separation, restrained color palette, material separation
STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic hyper-detailed character design, professional game character design sheet. Quality targets: photorealistic / lifelike priority; ultra-high detail; 8K-level visual detail; cinematic lighting quality.
